name: zero-bloat-skills
tagline_zh: 修硬件的人最缺的不是原理图，是「这一步该量哪个脚、正常值多少」。21 个技能把示波器读数、寄存器位。
tagline_en: Hardware techs don't lack schematics — they lack 'which pin to probe, what's normal.' 21 skills turn scope.
desc_en: 21 Circuit-Level Operational Skills for Hardware Technicians, Bare-Metal Linux & Multi-Agent AI Gateways • Megapass Intra Solusindo
why_zh: 每个技能都停在电路层：给的是探针位置、期望波形和判定阈值，不是泛泛的排查思路。
why_en: Every skill stops at the circuit level: probe points, expected waveforms, pass/fail thresholds — not generic troubleshooting.
limit_zh: 只覆盖硬件调试、裸机 Linux 和多智能体网关三块，写业务代码、做前端、调数据库的用不上。
limit_en: Covers only hardware debug, bare-metal Linux and multi-agent gateways — no web, DB or app-dev use. Gives thresholds and step order, not chip.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 21 circuit-level skills: soldering iron to bare-metal.
